caseStudy.challengeText: Skarda Nams was quoting manually across multiple metal types, running inventory on paper, and unable to produce compliant invoices without workarounds. Job costing was inaccurate. Shop-floor visibility was zero.
caseStudy.solutionText: Implemented Kenzap Factory with integrated quotation, production routing, and shop-floor execution modules. Peppol e-invoicing configured for EU compliance. Integrated with Moneo accounting software.
caseStudy.quote: "The operators adapted to the interface immediately, and our job costing is now reliable. Tax rates are handled automatically — that alone saves us significant time every month."

meta.title: Kenzap Nesting — DXF Sheet Nesting for Metal Fabricators
meta.description: Free native DXF sheet nesting software for metal fabricators. Import DXF parts, optimize sheets, preview live, and export cut-ready layouts.

hero.subheadline: A native desktop nesting app for metal fabricators. Drop your DXF parts, set quantities, run the engine — get a fully packed sheet ready to cut.

steps.title: Add DXF parts
steps.description: Drag and drop one or more DXF files. The engine detects all nestable shapes automatically, including multi-shape files.

steps.title: Review geometry
steps.description: Set quantities per part. Review internal cuts, engraving geometry, and layer assignments per shape before running.

steps.title: Configure the sheet
steps.description: Set plate dimensions, strip behaviour, spacing, rotation step, sheet margin, and engraving style.

steps.title: Run the engine
steps.description: Click RUN. A native binary handles placement — no cloud upload, no waiting. Results stream back live.

steps.title: Preview live
steps.description: Watch sheets populate as the algorithm works. See utilisation stats and sheet count update in real time.

steps.title: Export to DXF
steps.description: Export final sheets with all original layer structure, geometry reconstruction, and engraving geometry preserved.

performance.title: No cloud. No browser. Just fast.
performance.description: The nesting engine runs as a native binary on your machine. Large DXF files process in seconds, not minutes. Works fully offline — no subscription, no upload, no latency.

dxf.title: Full geometry support
dxf.description: Lines, arcs, circles, polylines, ellipses, and splines all supported. Internal cut geometry and engraving layers are preserved separately through export.

engraving.title: Two engraving styles built in
engraving.description: Simple mode for single-line lettering on thin materials. Stroked mode for outlined lettering with filled contours. Configured per job, preserved in DXF export.

sheet.title: Plate size optimisation
sheet.description: The engine finds the minimum plate count needed for your job. Configure sheet margin, part spacing, orientation step, and strip alignment independently.

workflow.title: Live preview while the algorithm runs
workflow.description: You don't wait for the engine to finish before seeing results. Sheets populate in real time as placements are confirmed. Change quantities or settings and rerun in seconds.
